review: Fresh bounded source-only review of frozen nine-module regularization and star-edge accounting packet
summary: No semantic defect found in the nine frozen modules within their explicit hypotheses and constituent scope. Exact source identity, prior-source continuity, actual graph objects, full simple quotient accounting, ordered incidence counts and witnessed minimization were checked independently. This is not a whole-paper certification or a proof of quantitative cleaning or the main upper theorem.

review_method.static_admission_or_unsafe_marker_scan_o: No sorry, admit, axiom, unsafe, implemented_by or extern marker found.

module_findings.domain: Finite simple bipartite G, natural ell and positive natural d, K >= 1, 0 <= eps1 < 1, eps2 > 0, ell*|B| <= |A| and minimum left degree d.
module_findings.assessment: The proof constructs a symmetric spanning H <= G with exact left degree d and |E(H)| = d*|A|, applies the actual dense-or-unmated alternative to H, and constructs stars inside H. The full quotient is fullStarContraction H C L, with selected stars and residual singleton branches. mapSupergraph changes only the host of its genuine bounded minor model; its branch sets remain unchanged. MateFreeOn is explicitly evaluated in H, never inferred in G. There is no deletion-heredity premise for Unmated.

module_findings.domain: Finite V and quotient label type I, arbitrary vertex map f; no surjectivity or injectivity premise.
module_findings.assessment: Crossing and internal edges are filters of the actual Sym2 host edge set. The crossing-edge image equals the edge set of the simple graph G.map f, suppressing loops and duplicate parallel images. Finset fiber counting gives the exact decomposition. Every fiber indexed by an actual quotient edge is nonempty before replacing its cardinality by 1 + (cardinality - 1), so natural subtraction loses no edge.

module_findings.domain: IsStarPacking G A C ell L with Disjoint A C; exact forest cardinality and final loss identity additionally require every selected leaf set to have cardinality ell.
module_findings.assessment: Existentially chosen covering labels are proved exact by branch disjointness. The branch-defined fullStarContraction is proved equal to G.map of those labels. Internal edges are precisely selected center-leaf forest edges: independent leaves rule out chords and singleton residual branches have no internal edges. Injectivity and disjointness give ell*|C| forest edges. The exact full edge-loss identity retains every quotient-edge fiber surplus explicitly.

module_findings.domain: Positive natural d, exact left degree d, |A| = ell*|B|, K >= 1, a supplied full ell-leaf star family centered at all B covering all V, and mate-freeness in the same host G.
module_findings.assessment: Bipartite degree sums bound the number of degree-large centers. C is literally the degree-small subset of B and M agrees with L there, empty elsewhere. Validity, fullness and original-host mate-freeness follow for these retained stars; regularity makes retained leaves small. Actual branch union cardinalities and the supplied full cover yield K*retainedVertexCount + ell*|V| >= K*|V|. This is deletion of selected stars only, with no cleaning certificate or graph-deletion heredity used.

module_findings.domain: The directed crossing sets and predicate exist generally. Their interpretation as exactly two opposite crossing host edges uses distinct centers in B, leaves in A, and bipartiteness of the same G; valid packings supply these leaf domains.
module_findings.assessment: The predicate demands distinct centers and singleton directed crossing-leaf sets in both directions, with unique witnessing leaves. starBetweenEdges is the actual image of adjacent vertex pairs between center-plus-leaf sets. Bipartiteness excludes center-center and leaf-leaf edges. The two oriented image sets are disjoint for distinct centers, so cardinality is exactly p+q. The informal bad-pair description is used only in that valid bipartite-star context.

module_findings.domain: Natural p,q for the fiber-surplus inequality; natural ell,count and real q >= 1 for absorption.
module_findings.assessment: The case split proves p+q-1 <= p*(p-1)+q*(q-1)+indicator(p=q=1), including empty and singleton boundary cases with natural truncated subtraction. The absorption inequality separately handles ell=0 before casting ell-1. These are numerical inequalities, not graph incidence premises, a quantitative cleaning theorem, or evidence of a source error.
module_findings.supporting_context: No graph construction is claimed in this module.

module_findings.domain: Fixed finite center set C, supplied valid full packing L in G, and original-host mate-free center-plus-leaf sets.
module_findings.assessment: The score is a literal finite count on C.product C filtered by IsBadStarPair: it counts ordered pairs. Nat.find uses L as an actual witness and selects the least realized natural score, with an actual assignment attaining it. Comparison competitors must preserve validity, fullness, the same mate-free host G, and exactly C.biUnion L. Centers remain fixed; no minimization oracle, swap lemma, quantitative bad-pair bound, or equivalence to an unordered score is assumed.

module_findings.domain: Valid star packing with disjoint center/leaf domains and distinct selected center labels. Cardinality additionally uses bipartiteness in G and C subset B.
module_findings.assessment: Both orientations of Sym2 equality are handled. Exact full-star labels identify the actual selected-selected quotient fiber with starBetweenEdges in the same original host G. The cardinality is p+q by the proved bipartite crossing-edge theorem. The identity also handles a zero fiber for a nonedge; it does not supply a bound for all quotient fibers or cover selected-residual allocation.

module_findings.domain: Finite simple G, finite leaf set S, and MateFreeOn G q S for the real collision bound.
module_findings.assessment: The exact equality counts ordered distinct leaf-pair/common-neighbor triples in two orders. Off-diagonal pairs and actual G.commonNeighbors are used, with no count oracle. The neighbor-slice count is the natural number r*(r-1), and the natural total and coefficient |S|*(|S|-1) are explicitly cast to real. The mate-free bound applies to each actual distinct ordered pair in S and yields the stated weak inequality; it does not silently divide by two or replace it with an unordered count.

primary_source_mapping.title: An even better Density Increment Theorem and its application to Hadwiger’s Conjecture
primary_source_mapping.author: Luke Postle
primary_source_mapping.mapping: Page 10 motivates the small-center restriction and defines bad pairs via exactly two opposite crossing edges. Page 11 motivates minimizing bad pairs on the same covered vertices and counting common-neighbor collisions in contraction losses. Page 12 motivates regularization followed by the small-dense/unmated alternative. The packet proves constituent statements with explicit domains, fixed centers, ordered scores and an unbounded residual fiber surplus. It does not formalize the later swap/counting claim, the complete cleaning lemma, or the concluding density bound. No Section 5 repair was attempted.

supplied_verification_evidence.observed: All nine named production BUILD entries have the two success markers. The supplied aggregate log reports a 774-declaration audit restricted to propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, the root/index success marker, and no index update needed. Both replay logs list precisely the nine reviewed production modules and their success markers.
supplied_verification_evidence.scope_caveat: These are inspected, supplied execution records, not independently rerun builds or kernel replays. The source-only review does not establish future exact-84 CI. accounting-build1.log also contains an unrelated trailing replaying MinorFreeSpanners.TwoStarLeafSwap line; it is excluded from this review and is not treated as a tenth gate.

scope_boundaries: RegularStarReduction gives a full covering quotient by adding residual singleton branches. It does not claim that the selected stars alone cover V. SmallStarRestriction separately requires a supplied full star cover and exact |A| = ell*|B|; the nine modules do not establish that intermediate pipeline automatically.
Mate-freeness after regularization is in H, while the bounded minor is also lifted to G. There is no claimed mate-freeness in the larger G and no assumed deletion-heredity of global Unmated.

MinimumBadStarFamily counts ordered bad center pairs and minimizes only among valid full original-host-mate-free assignments with fixed C and exactly the same covered leaves. Any later use of an unordered source count requires explicit accounting.
StarCrossingFiber treats selected-selected fibers. A global crossing-fiber allocation, including residual vertices and consistent ordered/unordered multiplicities, remains to be proved.
No quantitative bad-pair bound, leaf-swap argument, quantitative cleaning lemma, density-increment theorem, or main multiplicative-spanner upper theorem is certified by this packet.
TwoStarLeafSwapDraft.lean and any separate TwoStarLeafSwap artifact are outside the frozen manifest and were not reviewed.
The prior 75 library sources were checked for byte identity; this is not a fresh complete semantic review of those 75 modules.
Exact-84 remote CI and the whole-paper final audit remain separate gates.
